host.label: Server
host.description: The (fqdn) hostname of the SMB/CIFS/DFS server to connect to. For example mynas.local.

share.label: Share
share.description: The name of the share/service you'd like to connect to on the remote host, For example 'media'.

username.label: [%key:common::config_entries::username::label%]
username.description: The username to authenticate to the remote server. Leave as 'guest' or empty for anonymous access.

password.label: [%key:common::config_entries::password::label%]
password.description: The password to authenticate to the remote server. Leave empty for anonymous/guest access.

subfolder.label: Subfolder
subfolder.description: [optional] Use if your music is stored in a sublevel of the share. E.g. 'collections' or 'albums/A-K'.

smb_version.label: SMB Version
smb_version.description: The SMB protocol version to use. SMB 3.0 or higher is recommended for better performance and security. Use Auto to let the system negotiate.

cache_mode.label: Cache Mode
cache_mode.description: Cache mode affects performance and consistency. 'Loose' provides better performance for read-heavy workloads and is recommended for music libraries.

manifest.description: Play music and audiobooks stored on SMB connected network drives.
